## 2026

::: {.news-entry}

### October 1, 2026

I have joined [Department of Wind and Energy Systems (DTU Wind)](https://wind.dtu.dk/en) at [Technical University of Denmark](https://www.dtu.dk/english) as a Postdoctoral Researcher, where my research will contribute to operations and maintenance of wind turbines.

:::

::: {.news-entry}

### July 2026

The team I supervised received the **Audience Prize (€3,000)** at the **EWSHM 2026 Young Researcher Challenge**, working on data-driven detection of trends and anomalies in civil engineering applications. [Team members and supervision](../research-team/index.qmd#ewshm-2026-young-researcher-challenge).

:::

::: {.news-entry}

### January 29, 2026

The paper ["A comprehensive review of indirect bridge health monitoring"](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymssp.2026.113918) co-authored with Weiwei Lin, Chul-Woo Kim, Maria Pina Limongelli, and Eleni Chatzi has been published by [Mechanical Systems and Signal Processing](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/mechanical-systems-and-signal-processing).

:::

## 2024

::: {.news-entry}

### July 3, 2024

The paper  ["Investigation of time-varying frequencies of two-axle vehicles and bridges during interaction using drive-by methods and improved multisynchrosqueezing transform"](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymssp.2024.111677) co-authored with Yifu Lan, Kun Feng and Weiwei Lin has been published by [Mechanical Systems and Signal Processing](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/mechanical-systems-and-signal-processing).

:::

::: {.news-entry}

### July 2, 2024

The paper  ["Footbridge damage detection using smartphone-recorded responses of micromobility and convolutional neural networks"](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.autcon.2024.105587) co-authored with Yifu Lan and Weiwei Lin has been published by [Automation in Construction](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/automation-in-construction).

:::

::: {.news-entry}

### February 29, 2024

My doctoral thesis entitled ["Bridge health condition assessment using instrumented moving vehicles"](https://aaltodoc.aalto.fi/handle/123456789/123671) is granted the dean's doctoral dissertation award at [School of Engineering](https://www.aalto.fi/en/school-of-engineering), [Aalto University](https://www.aalto.fi/en). This award is granted in recognition of an outstanding doctoral dissertation and the research work conducted in its preparation, see the news [here](https://www.aalto.fi/en/news/a-view-of-2023-and-cheers-for-its-highlights-at-eng-awards-gala).

:::

::: {.news-entry}

### January 29, 2024

With [Prof. Yunpeng Wu](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=C6NejHgAAAAJ&hl=en), [Prof. Chuang He](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=Evl2XIcAAAAJ&hl=zh-CN), and [Prof. Li Ai ](https://liaiusc.github.io/), we are starting a special issue entitled ["Advanced Computer Vision Methods and Related Technologies in Structural Health Monitoring"](https://www.techscience.com/sdhm/special_detail/computer-vision_SHM) in the journal of [Structural Durability & Health Monitoring](https://www.techscience.com/journal/sdhm) (EI Indexed). This special issue aims to implement advanced intelligence technologies to monitor the structural health status of various devices and infrastructures in civil engineering, including railroad tracks, catenary, bridges, noise barrier, tunnels, etc. This will involve the utilization of cutting-edge sensors, such as high-definition camera, Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR), wireless sensor network, or drone sensing system.

:::

::: {.news-entry}

### January 17, 2024

The paper  ["Indirect frequency identification of footbridges with pedestrians using the contact-point response of shared scooters"](https://ascelibrary.org/doi/10.1061/JBENF2.BEENG-6344) co-authored with Yifu Lan and Weiwei Lin has been accepted by [Journal of Bridge Engineering](https://ascelibrary.org/journal/jbenf2).

:::

## 2023

::: {.news-entry}

### October 29, 2023

The paper  ["Physics-Guided Diagnosis Framework for Bridge Health Monitoring using Raw Vehicle Accelerations"](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymssp.2023.110899) authored by [Yifu Lan](https://www.aalto.fi/en/people/yifu-lan), myself, and [Weiwei Lin](https://people.aalto.fi/weiwei.lin) is accepted by [Mechanical Systems and Signal Processing](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/mechanical-systems-and-signal-processing). In this paper, I helped with developing Finite Element Model (FEM) of the vehicle-bridge interaction process using MATLAB. Congrats to Yifu, well deserved!

:::

::: {.news-entry}

### October 6, 2023

I am happy to share that I have had my defense at Aalto University with thesis entitled ["Bridge health condition assessment using instrumented moving vehicles"](https://aaltodoc.aalto.fi/handle/123456789/123671). Thank you all for the help in this interesting journey!

:::

::: {.news-entry}

### September 18, 2023

The paper  ["Bridge Frequency Identification in City Bus Monitoring: A Coherence-PPI Algorithm "](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0141029623013287) authored by [Yifu Lan](https://www.aalto.fi/en/people/yifu-lan), myself, Keijo Koski, Ludovic Fülöp, Timo Tirkkonen and [Weiwei Lin](https://people.aalto.fi/weiwei.lin) is accepted by [Engineering Structures](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/engineering-structures). Congrats to Yifu!

:::

::: {.news-entry}

### July 21, 2023

Together with [Dr. Mario Puppio](https://web.unica.it/unica/page/it/mariol_puppio), [Dr. Marco Tanganelli](https://www.unifi.it/p-doc2-2013-200002-T-3f2a3d32392b29.html), and [Dr. Filippo Landi ](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Filippo-Landi-3), we are managing a special issue entitled ["Evaluation of Buildings’ and Infrastructures’ Performance and Analysis of Seismic and Naturally Induced Disasters"](https://www.mdpi.com/journal/applsci/special_issues/W8X6088P6L) in the journal of [Applied Sciences](https://www.mdpi.com/journal/applsci) (IF=2.7). Research on new design strategies, modern architectural and structural concepts for the new structures, machine learning, innovation in material technology or construction chain, or the retrofit of the ancient and traditional structures will be considered for publication.

:::

::: {.news-entry}

### July 20, 2023

The paper  ["High-Fidelity Time-Series Data Synthesis based on Finite Element Simulation and Data Space Mapping"](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0888327023005381?via%3Dihub) authored by [Youqi Zhang](https://www.aalto.fi/en/people/youqi-zhang), myself, [Rui Hao](https://www.aalto.fi/en/people/rui-hao), [Weiwei Lin](https://people.aalto.fi/weiwei.lin), [Lingfang Li](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Lingfang_Li4) and [Di Su](https://www.u-tokyo.ac.jp/focus/en/people/k0001_01329.html) is accepted by [Mechanical Systems and Signal Processing](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/mechanical-systems-and-signal-processing). In this paper, I was responsible for Finite Element Modeling using Abaqus driven by Python. One interested in this paper can find its preprint version in [Publications](../publications/index.qmd).

:::

::: {.news-entry}

I am attending [IALCCE 2023](https://ialcce2023.org/) in Milano, Italy. More pictures can be found [HERE](../gallery.qmd). Thanks, all friends, for the interesting topics and nice dinner.
